commentary.text: 90+12' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+11' Mallorca have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+9' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
90+8' Chiquinho (Mallorca) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
90+7' Jose Copete (Mallorca) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
90+5' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
90+2' The resulting set piece from Mallorca is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+2' CHANCE! Chiquinho (Mallorca) goes very close! He gathers a cross inside the box and fires a sublime shot towards the right side of the goal, but Joan Garcia produces an excellent save.
90' There will be a minimum of 11 min. of added time.
90' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Francisco Maeso didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
90' The resulting free kick from Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
